raw_response:
This plot is very small, only 0.06 hectares, and it has my perennial trees — probably some coffee and maybe enset or fruit trees mixed in, as is common here in SNNP. I own the land, so I take care of it, but I cannot afford much chemical fertilizer for trees when my other plots need it more for food crops. I will put manure from my animals around the trees like I always do, and weed by hand with my family. Rain is usually enough here in the highlands, so I do not irrigate, and pests on these trees I just manage by pruning and cleaning — pesticide costs too much.
